data.intent: Add opt-in OpenTelemetry distributed tracing to the Cicadas CLI so each initiative produces a single linked trace from kickoff through archive, exported via OTLP HTTP to any configurable backend.

Create the core tracing.py module with OTel null-object fallback, add the optional tracing dependency group to pyproject.toml, and add the tracing config stub to init.py's generated config.json template.
